steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: ...Cheh.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hm? What's this pause for?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Don't tell me I was a little too heavy-handed, and hurt you in my carelessness, young lady?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph. So you know some flowery kung fu. Happy?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Your buccaneer's already fled on us, so there's no sense tangling with you any longer, you—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —What's your name?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Nothing. The latter man of Tzu-hsu and Wu-yu.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Keh. What kind of conman gives his real name? That must be some stupid kung fu stage name.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ah, how keen-witted you are.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: So you're not going to let me past to chase them, right?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hence why I compliment your keen wit.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Shut it with your flapping!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: What are you waiting for?! Let's take him!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Miss! We'll help you out!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: —Hold it!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Eep...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: This is still an inn. I can't have you two making a mess of the restaurant and fools of us all. What will the passersby think?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: ...Cheh.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: However, you two fought marvelously. In honor of your eye-opening display, I... won't ask you to cover the costs.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But for now, please rein it in. Call it a day. For my sake.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Do pardon us, good proprietor. We'll resolve this misunderstanding forthwith, then make amends at your door.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I'll let you go... this time. For the innkeep.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I don't know how you're involved with that guy, but I'd hand him over if I were you.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Cover for him and you're an accomplice. You're free to go for now, but Shangshu doesn't tolerate outlaws.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: If this were simply a matter of outlawry, you could have called the police. What has you resorting to force, Miss Du?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Nothing is right. No matter the reason, a mere disagreement shouldn't bring you to fisticuffs.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Why you...!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Now, now, Miss.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Let's have your people leave.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: M-Miss, do we just let him go...? We could grab him, then wait for the Lungmenite to take the bait—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Quiet.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: We've already let the Lungmenite escape. Keeping this guy with us all night wouldn't be much use.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Besides, could you even restrain him? And you, you're still holding back some moves, aren't you?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hardly. Friendship is wealth, now, friendship is wealth. If the young lady here is willing to take a step back, then I couldn't ask for anything more...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I won't forget this, Nothing.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Please, don't waste your memories on me. The esteemed have so much to forget.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (Carefully, carefully... Good, I'll get a decent head start from here.)

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I'm only listening to Mr. Zheng—if you want to see how things play out outside, be my guest. I suggest you sit tight and listen to—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —Hey! Where'd he go?!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: H-How did this happen?! What are you all DOING?!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Er... you weren't exactly clear on whether we were letting him go, Miss...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Don't just stand there! After him!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Y-Yes, Miss!

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Hey, Miss Du, don't you think you're making too big of a mess?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Ai, ai, don't—whatever, this isn't my problem anymore...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: And Dad! Why were acting like this doesn't concern you? You even stopped me!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You were making trouble.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Trouble, my ass! You knew they'd go through Yingfeng Road, right? Isn't that why you were here waiting for them?!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: We've got eyes in dozens of inns and eateries in this city! Catching some blind idiot of a thief's not hard—

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Who's the blind idiot here?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You don't know what that wine cup is, let alone what that Lungmenite might have up his sleeve.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Not to mention how capable those people were. If they were willing to cause a commotion, they'd have won, and come out looking reasonable too.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: But––

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But what? Do you know just how significant their mission is? Or who the anonymous client is?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You think you're all it takes to put hired escorts to shame?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Looks like no one's following.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Sorry everyone. I should've been leading the way, but here we are in this plight.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I never imagined something like this would await us in Shangshu City though...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Was it really alright to leave that young man alone? Have we abandoned him?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The innkeeper and the pushy woman seemed to know each other. I'm worried our rearguard hero might not slip away so easily.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Huh... how do you figure, Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: She was clearly mindful of him while making her move. That'd never fool me.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Get fooled in my line of work, and you're out business.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Then we can only hope he's a fast runner. And honestly, I'd vouch for that.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Will he really be okay?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: He'll be right as rain. The girl wouldn't dare to make a scene in broad daylight, right? It's a quiet street, but SOMEONE's gonna notice.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Phew... That's a relief. But fancy meeting you Rhodes Islanders here.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And what brings you to Shangshu, Mr. Lee? Commission at your office?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I suppose. Just a private matter entrusted to me by an old friend though.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Is it that box?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That it is.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But this truly is bizarre. Why would anyone in Shangshu dare to steal Mr. Liang's property?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's not bizarre at all. If we could slip into Shangshu without a fuss, why would our Mr. Liang have bothered to seek me out?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Mr. Liang?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: An old schoolmate... You can think of him as the Wei Yenwu of Shangshu.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Wow then... Mr. Wei, huh...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: By the sound of it, you all know Lord Wei of Lungmen quite well?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Maybe the average man on the street wouldn't, but those of us sifting through Lungmen's scraps? Sure, we all do.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Recognizing Lord Wei and being recognized by him are very different things.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're not wrong, but let's leave me and Wei Yenwu's somewhat rocky relationship out of this.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Ah. A shame I'll never meet anyone of Lord Wei's caliber.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Sure, he's extraordinary, but not THAT extraordinary.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You're kinda making it sound like Mr. Liang's no big deal by comparison.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Does he count as a big deal?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: He does. Why wouldn't he?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Wait, do you mean Lord Wei of Lungmen doesn't, or Mr. Liang doesn't?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Then I suppose everyone's a big deal these days, tut-tut-tut. Back then, he was just a hothead who didn't even know the meaning of the word 'adapt'.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You're the same as ever, huh Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hah. What's it matter now, with me eking out my days in Lungmen while he officiates all of Shangshu? We haven't met in forever.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Look, there. It's that young man.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Nothing! Alright, mate?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ow, ow, ow, ow! Hands off, I'm aching all over...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You may not realize this, but that young girl just now went utterly berserk! Merely warding her off tested every bone in me, and it was only by the proprietor's timely intervention that I had a gap through which to scurry—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: With the way you came running over, you're obviously completely fine.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Fan tucked in hand and everything. So care to repeat that? Tested every bone?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Erk... There's no fooling you, benefactor... I will say, though, it's been far too long since I last used so many moves. The muscle ache alone is...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And this young man is?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Operator Mr. Nothing.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I may not have formally taken the post, but my devoted heart and tireless efforts have long since beaten to Rhodes Island's tune.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So you're a new operator friend. Good to meet you.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Well met, well met. I hear from my benefactor that you're also an ally to Rhodes Island? Ah, as expected of Rhodes Island, friend to all and beloved by the masses, that they'd strike an accord with a fine soul like yourself, er...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just call me old Lee.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: How kind of you, Brother Lee.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well then, brother. You say you only got out once the innkeeper intervened?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Precisely so. What of it?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm... seems things aren't as simple as I thought.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: This isn't the place to stand and chat, too many ears. I'd never forgive myself for another setback.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Then we'll head straight for the Liang estate.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: As for our friends...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I was only told to meet with you. Bringing any more could be a little...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Ah, never mind.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I doubt Mr. Liang's so small-minded. And you did both help us out, so we'll go together.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The Liang estate, huh... I'd really rather not bother anyone else...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's fine, you're with me.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Decisive words, Brother Lee.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Good... if that's settled, then let's be quick. Come, this way.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Brother Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm? Ah... I'll be right there.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What's this...? Are these strange pets the new trend in Shangshu?

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Brother Lee! Don't fall behind!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: ...I'm coming, I'm coming.

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao...
